home.subtitle: Start everyday office work, inspect current tasks, and manage the information your assistant can use.
home.startHint: Choose an example to place a complete instruction in the task box. Nothing runs until you send it.

reimbursement.title: Prepare a reimbursement package
reimbursement.prompt: Organize the attached invoices and receipts into a reimbursement checklist. Flag missing dates, amounts, categories, or approvals, and create a clear summary for me to review before submission.

requirements.title: Turn notes into requirements
requirements.prompt: Turn the attached notes into a requirements document with goals, users, scope, acceptance criteria, open questions, and risks. Mark every assumption and do not invent missing facts.

data.title: Analyze a data file
data.prompt: Analyze the attached spreadsheet. Check data quality first, then summarize key changes, unusual values, and conclusions supported by the data. Create a concise table of findings.

market.title: Prepare a market brief
market.prompt: Prepare a market brief for the topic I provide. Separate sourced facts from inference, compare the main alternatives, and list the evidence and dates behind each important conclusion.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.subtitle: These are your real conversations and their current state.
tasks.manageHint: Open a task to inspect its messages and state. Stop an active run, add files, or amend requirements in the conversation so the existing execution and history controls are preserved.

status.preparationTimedOut: Environment preparation took too long. Retry to continue.
status.preparationFailed: Environment preparation did not finish. Review the reason below and retry.
status.capabilityForbidden: This account is not authorized to use the workspace. Ask your administrator to check employee roles and grants.
status.environmentUnavailable: The execution environment is unavailable. Retry, or ask your administrator to check the service.
status.bootstrapLoadFailed: The page could not load. Reload to try again.
status.identityExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
status.resourceUpdatePending: The capability update is queued until execution and workspace leases are safely released. Existing authorized capabilities remain available.
status.resourceCheckDeferred: Capability updates could not be checked. Existing authorized capabilities remain available; a check will run later.

errors.authentication: Your session has expired. Returning to sign-in now.
errors.forbidden: This account does not have access to this ability. Contact your organization administrator for access.
errors.noModel: No model is available to this account. Ask your organization administrator to check the default model and access.
errors.noCapability: No work capabilities are authorized for this account. Contact an administrator.
errors.prepareFailed: The work environment could not be prepared ({{code}}). Retry, or contact an administrator if it persists.

files.title: Files
files.subtitle: Browse task, personal, shared, and generated files with their saved versions.
files.restoreConfirm: Restore {{name}} to the version saved at {{time}}?
files.warnings: {{count}} files could not be fully read or versioned. Refresh and review the list.
files.diffTruncated: This file is long. Only the first 1,000 lines are shown.
files.continuePrompt: Continue working with the workspace file "{{path}}". Read and confirm its current content first, then apply my next instruction. Save a new file or version instead of overwriting the original unless I explicitly ask.
files.officePreviewHint: This browser does not currently support an inline preview of this Office file. You can read or continue working with it in a task, or download the original file to view it.
files.unsupportedPreviewHint: This file type cannot be safely previewed here. Download the original file instead.

knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.subtitle: Upload source material, follow indexing results, search original passages, and inspect exact versions.
knowledge.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}} and revoke it from future use?
knowledge.empty: Choose a knowledge base or add its first document
knowledge.availableEmpty: No knowledge base is available. Create a private one, or ask an administrator to grant access.

issues.fileType: This file type is not supported. Upload a PDF, Office file, image, Markdown, text, CSV, or JSON file.
issues.invalidDocument: This document could not be read. Re-export it from its source application, then upload the new copy.
issues.utf8: Save this text file as UTF-8, then upload it again.
issues.noText: No searchable text was found. Upload a text-based copy or an OCR-processed version.
issues.tooLarge: This document exceeds an indexing limit. Split or reduce the file, then upload the smaller parts.
issues.ocrUnavailable: OCR for this document is unavailable. Upload a text-based copy or ask an administrator to enable the required OCR language.
issues.contentChanged: The stored file changed before reindexing. Upload it as a new version to keep the version history accurate.
issues.temporary: Document extraction could not finish. Retry once; if it repeats, re-export the file or contact an administrator ({{code}}).
issues.failed: Indexing failed ({{code}}). Check the file and retry, or upload a corrected version.

knowledge.scopeDefault: Current authorized knowledge; expert defaults apply
knowledge.scopeHint: Whole bases use their current indexed version. Individual files keep the selected version. An empty selection excludes knowledge from this task. Access is checked again when used.
knowledge.duplicateReused: The identical file is already present; its existing document and indexing job were reused.
knowledge.noMatches: No matching evidence was found in the selected knowledge base.
knowledge.sourceUnavailable: Source v{{version}} is unavailable or access has changed ({{code}}). This reference has not been redirected to a different version.
knowledge.historicalSource: You are viewing cited v{{version}}. The current indexed version is v{{indexed}}.

abilities.title: Abilities
abilities.subtitle: View models and abilities provided by your organization or created personally. Organization defaults are inherited automatically.
abilities.personalEmpty: You have no personal abilities. Organization-provided abilities remain available under All available.
abilities.modelsEmpty: No models are available to this account. Ask an administrator to check the organization default model and access.
abilities.name: Name
abilities.nativeOfficeDescription: Provided by the workspace with the organization default model {{model}} and available to new tasks. This is a native workspace capability, not an MCP catalog connection.
abilities.packageHint: Select one folder containing exactly one SKILL.md. Companion files are imported with their relative paths and binary contents preserved.
abilities.packageSkillFile: Choose one ability package folder containing exactly one SKILL.md.
abilities.packageImported: Ability package imported with {{count}} companion files.
abilities.linkedSkills: Skill packages available to this assistant

mcp.title: MCP connection
mcp.enterpriseAvailable: An enterprise connection is available with status {{status}}. A ready personal connection takes priority for your tasks.
mcp.credentialKeep: Leave blank to keep the saved credential
mcp.clearCredential: Clear the saved credential and disable this connection
mcp.saved: Connection saved. Run a test before using it.
mcp.testPassed: Connection passed in {{latency}} ms; {{count}} tools discovered.
mcp.testFailed: Connection test failed. Review the error and credential.
mcp.testHint: Save and test the connection to discover its tools.

abilities.linkedMcps: MCP connections available to this assistant
abilities.resourcesRefreshed: Authorized resources are synced. Running tasks keep their current abilities; new tasks use the update.
abilities.resourcesRefreshFailed: Could not sync authorized resources ({{code}}). Nothing was opened.
abilities.resourcesRefreshBusy: A task is running, so abilities cannot be refreshed yet. Let it finish, refresh again, and use the update in your next task.
abilities.packageBudgetWarning: Some skill packages exceeded the 48 MiB per-user runtime import budget and were skipped ({{issues}}). Other abilities and normal sign-in continue to work.
abilities.runtimeIssuesWarning: Some catalog abilities are unavailable in the current runtime ({{issues}}). Enabled here means authorized and configured; review these runtime issues before use.

memory.title: Memory and schedules
memory.subtitle: Review and maintain information saved for future work. Scheduled tasks remain in the existing scheduler.
memory.scopeHint: Personal memory follows your account. Project memory applies only to the project ID you specify and is never promoted to enterprise scope automatically.
memory.deleteConfirm: This removes the selected saved memory.

preview.basicHint: Basic preview; the original remains downloadable. Excel shows 100 rows per page and up to 40 columns. Word/PPT shows text and tables; download for complex layouts, images and charts. Office preview limit: 25MB.
preview.limitedHint: Some content is truncated or {{count}} formulas cannot be recalculated. Original formulas are shown; stale cached values are never used. Download to verify.
preview.configurationError: Configuration is not ready ({{code}}). Refresh or ask an administrator to check the default model, assistant and capabilities.
preview.busy: Another file is being previewed. Please retry shortly.
preview.tooLarge: This file exceeds the preview size limit. Download the original.
preview.timeout: Preview timed out. Retry or download the original.
preview.failed: Preview failed ({{code}}). Retry, or download and inspect the original.

delivery.retryPrompt: First check current artifacts and errors. Continue only unfinished or failed steps; do not regenerate completed outputs. Pending: {{paths}}

work.scope: Knowledge scope: {{bases}} libraries, {{documents}} fixed document versions
work.reviewRecovery: I have reviewed completed outputs and any uncertain external actions before resuming.
work.continuation: Add information or describe the next change

reasons.CORE_CAPACITY_WAIT: Accepted and waiting for an available employee execution environment.
reasons.BACKGROUND_AUTHORIZATION_UNAVAILABLE: Background authorization could not be saved. This execution was not started; sign in again or contact your administrator.
reasons.TASK_AUTHORIZATION_REVOKED: Employee or task authorization was revoked. Restricted execution has stopped.
reasons.TASK_QUEUE_WAIT_EXPIRED: The durable queue wait limit was reached. The task is retained; retry when capacity is available.
reasons.SERVICE_RESTART_REVIEW_BEFORE_RESUME: The service restarted during execution. Review saved outputs and uncertain operations before continuing.
reasons.TASK_RUNTIME_INTERRUPTED: The execution environment was interrupted. Saved task data and outputs are retained.
reasons.TASK_ACCEPTANCE_UNCERTAIN: The execution acknowledgement is uncertain. Check existing results before any retry.
reasons.REQUIRED_ARTIFACTS_MISSING: Some required deliverables are missing or invalid. Available files are shown; retry the unfinished steps.
reasons.MODEL_EXECUTION_FAILED: The model execution failed. Saved outputs are retained.
reasons.TOOL_STEPS_UNFINISHED: Some tools failed. Review the steps and retry the unfinished portion.
reasons.RESULT_REQUIRES_REVIEW: The available execution evidence does not establish completion. Review and continue.
reasons.TASK_EXECUTION_UNAVAILABLE: Execution could not be verified. Review details and retry safely.
reasons.USER_CANCELLED: Cancelled by the employee. Existing outputs are retained.
reasons.USER_CANCEL_REQUESTED: A stop was requested; waiting for the actual execution to stop.
reasons.TASK_EXECUTION_TIME_LIMIT: The execution time limit was reached. Stopping the task and retaining available results.
reasons.RESOURCE_UPDATE_WAIT: Waiting for active work to finish safely and current capabilities to synchronize. The task remains queued.

progress.TOOL_FAILED: A tool failed; see task details

errors.TASK_QUEUE_FULL: The execution queue is full. This request was not accepted; try again after another task releases capacity.
errors.TASK_BUSY: This task already has an active execution. Wait or cancel it before submitting different instructions.
errors.TASK_RECOVERY_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Review the existing results and uncertain external actions before resuming.
errors.TASK_ATTEMPT_CHANGED: The task has advanced to another execution. Refresh before acting.
errors.TASK_INPUT_REQUIRED: Add the required information or describe the next step.
errors.TASK_HISTORY_CAPACITY: Task history capacity has been reached. Contact your administrator to archive it.
errors.TASK_ATTEMPT_CAPACITY: This task has reached its execution history limit. Contact your administrator.
errors.TASK_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: Task status is temporarily unavailable. Retry; do not resubmit the original work.
errors.TASK_REQUEST_CONFLICT: This submission identifier was used for different input. Refresh and retry.
errors.TASK_NOT_FOUND: This task does not exist or is not accessible to your account.
errors.TASK_EXTERNAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Verify the previous external operation outcome first.

work.externalReview: The previous external operation has an unknown outcome. Verify it before continuing; it will not be replayed automatically.
